description: Every Belgian rail lookup the existing tools offer, plus transfer-risk, delay history and accessibility data that none of them have.

novel_features.name: Transfer risk under live delay
novel_features.description: Tells you whether the transfers in a journey still hold once today's delays are applied.

novel_features.name: Route punctuality history
novel_features.description: Shows how reliable a train or route has actually been, from delay observations recorded on your machine.

novel_features.name: Disruptions scoped to one journey
novel_features.description: Filters the national disruption feed down to the stations your journey actually passes through.

novel_features.name: Live observation capture
novel_features.description: Records what the board says right now into local SQLite, building the history other commands read.

novel_features.name: Latest safe departure
novel_features.description: Answers the last train you can take and still arrive before a deadline, accounting for current delays.

novel_features.name: Station facilities and accessibility
novel_features.description: Reports step-free access, elevators, ramps, lockers, bike parking and ticket-desk hours for a station.

novel_features.name: What changed since last check
novel_features.description: Reports new delays, cancellations and platform changes since the last time you looked.
